title: Ads Pack
description: Schema for ad pack drafts produced by the Ads Pack Agent. No live ad spend without Owner Approved status.

brand_id.description: Brand identifier. Default: VQ for Vị Cuốn.

funnel_stage.description: Where this ad sits in the customer funnel.

target_audience.description: Audience description. Must not contain PII.
target_audience.example: Office workers in Vinh, 22-40, interested in Vietnamese food and delivery

angle.description: Creative angle and positioning hook for this ad.
angle.example: Fresh rolls, picked up in 5 minutes — lunchtime solved.

headline.description: Short headline shown in the ad unit.
headline.example: Bữa trưa tươi ngon — Giao nhanh tận nơi

description.description: Optional short description line below headline.

creative_brief_ref.description: Reference to the creative brief ID for the visual asset.

offer.description: Any offer included. Must be Owner-provided. Use [OWNER_TO_PROVIDE_OFFER] if pending.

compliance_notes.description: Compliance flags or notes for this ad. E.g., no health claims, no fake scarcity.

approval_status.description: Approval state. Ad spend cannot happen without Approved status.

created_by_agent.description: Agent that created this ads pack.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this ads pack was created.

notes.description: Optional notes for the Owner or Reviewer.
